brief.headline: Push Gujarat Ambuja's dextrose price down 3.0% to match Sayaji's ₹66.48/KG — we're overpaying ₹1.26 Cr a year for the same material

priceAsk.summary: Ask for ₹66.48/KG on Dextrose Anhydrous IP — a 3.0% reduction from our current ₹68.45/KG
priceAsk.basis: We already pay Sayaji Industries ₹66.48/KG for the same material. The open market shows dextrose typically selling at ₹66–73/kg, so our target sits right in that fair band. There's no reason to pay Gujarat Ambuja more when we know ₹66.48/KG is achievable.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Keep 30 Days After Receipt — no change needed

brief.financialLeverage: Gujarat Ambuja publishes no financials, so we can't see inside their books. What we do know: they supply 56% of our dextrose (₹21.21 Cr spend), making us a big customer for them. Because their finances aren't public and we're concentrated with them, our best move is to stay firm on price — benchmark to Sayaji's ₹66.48/KG — and run a parallel process to line up a second qualified source. That second source is the real leverage: once they know we can split the business, the price conversation gets easier.

evidence.point: We pay Gujarat Ambuja ₹68.45/KG but Sayaji gives us the same dextrose for ₹66.48/KG
That 3.0% gap costs us ₹1.26 Cr every year in extra spend
Gujarat Ambuja supplies more than half our dextrose — we're a major customer for them
Market asking prices for dextrose anhydrous IP run ₹60–81/kg, typically ₹66–73/kg — our ₹66.48/KG target sits in the fair middle
India's export unit value for dextrose is ₹42.95/kg — well below what we pay, showing plenty of global supply

alternates.name: Sayaji Industries Limited (current supplier)
alternates.why: Already supplying us at ₹66.48/KG — the benchmark price we want Gujarat Ambuja to match

alternates.name: Tirupati Starch & Chemicals Ltd
alternates.why: A lead to qualify (verify before RFQ): Listed Indore maize wet-miller making Dextrose Anhydrous in IV-fluid grade — exact form match; confirm IP monograph certificate of analysis before switching

alternates.name: Gulshan Polyols Ltd
alternates.why: A lead to qualify (verify before RFQ): Listed starch & polyol maker, established in dextrose/sorbitol — described as a drop-in alternate to Gujarat Ambuja and Sayaji

risks: Gujarat Ambuja is our main dextrose source (56%) — if we push too hard without a second supplier approved and ready, we risk supply disruption
Their financials aren't public, so we can't gauge how tight their cash is or how much room they have to cut price — proceed carefully and watch for any signs of supply trouble
We have no worst-terms flag on payment, so there's no extra cash lever to trade — the negotiation hinges entirely on price and our ability to credibly walk to an alternate
Market backups like Roquette India and Ingredion India are premium, very reliable suppliers but may come at higher cost — use them as quality benchmarks, not necessarily price levers
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We value the partnership, but we need to talk about price: we're paying you ₹68.45 a kilo when Sayaji gives us ₹66.48 for the same dextrose — can you match that?
